14 Mar 1973
Mr. Nathaniel Reed US Department of Interior Washington, D.C. 20340
Dear Mr. Reed,
Attached is a position paper of the Milwaukee Audubon Society dealing with the subject of Off The Road Recreational Vehicles on Public Land.
It is our understanding that public reaction was invited to a draft statement on ORV use issued by one of Interior's subagencies - the Eureau of Outdoor Recreation.
We trust that you will see that our position on the ORV matter gets to the proper agency in time for the hearing on this matter.
Sincerely
David Tillotson
President - Milwaukee
Audubon Society
12259 Underwood Fkwy
Wauwatosa, Wis 53226
CC: Cynthia Wilson (Natl Audubon)
CC: Ed Brigham (Natl Midwest Audubon Rep)
